holdoutSelection.rule: exclude V35-P holdout books Isa, Hos, 2Ch, Eze; rank remaining canonical books by md5('v36-holdout|' || canonical_book_code); take four lowest hashes

visibleGlyphUnit.tokenRule: primary analysis retains tokens carrying exactly one qualifying mark; tokens with zero or multiple qualifying marks are excluded
visibleGlyphUnit.pathRule: three consecutive canonical tokens, each retained by tokenRule

primaryModel.description: training-only glyph-emission model over supported operator types; score a candidate three-operator path by the sum of log P(observed shape cluster_i | candidate operator_i)
primaryModel.smoothing: alpha=5 toward the training-wide shape-cluster distribution
primaryModel.candidatePaths: three-operator paths observed at least five times in training and composed only of operator types with at least twenty training occurrences

primaryEndpoints: exact three-operator path top1/top5/top10/top50 and median rank
real order versus reversed and deterministic within-path shuffle
freezeRule: no feature, holdout, support-threshold, scoring, smoothing, or candidate-inventory change after recovery outcomes are opened; any change becomes a separately labeled robustness analysis or new protocol
